harborpass/customer-facing-retention-pol: HarborPass current customer-facing retention policy (permanent, established by issue trial-6ui on 2026-09-07, superseding release 1.0): every notice and export request, regardless of renewal date, sends notices 14 calendar days before renewal_on; members with completed_years >= 3 earn credit = floor(15% of plan_cents) capped at 3600 cents; members below 3 completed years get credit 0; autopay does not affect eligibility; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents. Request/response shapes and the CSV format are unchanged. This is the product requirement for subsequent features; the superseded 1.0 policy (21-day lead, 10% credit only with autopay and 2+ years, cap 2400) survives only in the archived support_replay case.
harborpass/support-replay-frozen-release: HarborPass support_replay (case IOS-1842, issue trial-42h) must permanently return the frozen release-1.0 renewal-preview values: send_on = renewal_on minus 21 calendar days; credit only when autopay is true AND completed_years >= 2, credit = floor(10% of plan_cents) capped at 2400 cents, else 0; amount_due_cents = plan_cents minus credit_cents; customer_id copied unchanged. Since trial-6ui replaced the customer-facing notice/export policy, support_replay must NOT delegate to notice(): it uses its own frozen implementation (release_1_notice in main.py, with RELEASE_1_* constants). Any future customer-facing policy changes leave these frozen values untouched.
